svg.title: FastVCL: sparse-to-tube video copy localization framework
svg.desc: Proposed method from the manuscript: fixed ISC descriptors, normalization and masks, sampling grids, tiled mutual Top-K, deduplicated anchors, RANSAC with dual-axis support and gap splitting, finite tubes, in-tube cosine similarity and zero-floored local DP, traceback, trimming, scoring and two-axis deduplication. Matrices and trajectories are schematic, not empirical outputs.
svg.text: Distinct-time support on A and B
Local DP with a zero restart
Output: (a_s, b_s, a_e, b_e, q) · feature-index coordinates
